title: Regular-base polynomial formal fibre
statement: Let A be a characteristic-zero regular local ring (thus Noetherian and a domain), q a maximal ideal of A[X] contracting to its maximal ideal, and r ≤ q a prime contracting to zero in A; r may be zero. Then κ(r) tensor over A[X] with the maximal-ideal-adic completion of A[X]_q is a regular ring. Completeness of A is not assumed. The polynomial ring, completion and residue-field fibre use [def-weil-polynomial-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]; Noetherianity is [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Regularity is in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme], applied to the affine spectrum.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 07PV, paragraph 4 and Lemma 07PU

proof.text: Mathlib Polynomial.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime_of_comap_eq_maximalIdeal gives regularity at q. Its completion is regular local, hence a regular ring.
For r=0 the fibre is a localization. For nonzero r, extend to K[X], take an irreducible generator f, and identify the fibre with R/(f), where R is the localization of the completion at A minus zero.
Extend d/dX to R. In characteristic zero, f and its derivative are coprime; Bezout gives a unit derivative modulo f. The derivation criterion makes the quotient regular.

theorem regularBase_formalFibre_isRegular
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] [CharZero A]
    (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal]
    (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q)
    (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) :
    IsRegularRing (r.Fiber
      (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
        (Localization.AtPrime q)))
